title: Case split on #H <= #A closes the polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa conjecture
intent: Reduce the polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa conjecture to a finite group, obtain a subgroup H from the auxiliary lemma PFR_conjecture_aux, then split on whether |H| ≤ |A|; one branch reuses H and finishes with |c| ≤ K^12, the other shrinks H to a subgroup H' and covers A by cosets of H' to finish with |c| < 2·K^12.
also_known_as: binary case analysis on a cardinality bound

parent.name: PFR_conjecture
parent.statement:
theorem PFR_conjecture {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Module (ZMod 2) G]
    {A : Set G} {K : ℝ} (hA₀ : A.Nonempty) (Afin : A.Finite)
    (hA : (A + A).ncard ≤ K * A.ncard) :
    ∃ (H : Submodule (ZMod 2) G) (c : Set G), c.Finite ∧ (H : Set G).Finite ∧
      Nat.card c < 2 * K ^ 12 ∧ (H : Set G).ncard ≤ A.ncard ∧ A ⊆ c + H

children.name: PFR_conjecture_aux
children.statement:
lemma PFR_conjecture_aux (hA₀ : A.Nonempty) (hA : (A + A).ncard ≤ K * A.ncard) :
    ∃ (H : Submodule (ZMod 2) G) (c : Set G),
    Nat.card c ≤ K ^ (13/2 : ℝ) * A.ncard ^ (1/2 : ℝ) * (H : Set G).ncard ^ (-1/2 : ℝ) ∧
      (H : Set G).ncard ≤ K ^ 11 * A.ncard ∧ A.ncard ≤ K ^ 11 * (H : Set G).ncard ∧ A ⊆ c + H
children.closed_by: a 102-line proof: entropic_PFR_conjecture produces H close to A (line 174); entropy/cardinality estimates (diff_ent_le_rdist, exp_monotone) give the two K^11 bounds (lines 196-203); Set.ruzsa_covering_add (lines 248-249) yields the covering set c

children.name: PFR_conjecture_pos_aux'
children.closed_by: two positivity `have`s closed by `simpa [Set.ncard_pos (hA.add hA)]` and `simpa [...] using mul_pos_iff.1 (card_AA_pos.trans_le hAK)`, then `exact`

applicability.goal_shape: an existence goal ∃ H c, (bounds on c and H) ∧ A ⊆ c + H, where an auxiliary lemma has already produced a candidate H and the remaining work depends on a size comparison |H| ≤ |A|
applicability.use_when: the argument divides cleanly on a total-order dichotomy over a size or measure; one branch reuses the produced object and the other must shrink it; both branches close by the same kind of `calc` chain
applicability.avoid_when: the two branches need genuinely different constructions (make each a separate lemma instead); the dichotomy's exhaustiveness is not already supplied by a library lemma (then it must be stated as its own fact); the measure comparison is not the natural cut point of the argument

claims.claim: The parent PFR_conjecture closes from its children and the split `rcases le_or_gt ((H : Set G).ncard) A.ncard with h|h` (line 294): the `#H ≤ #A` branch uses PFR_conjecture_aux and a `calc` ending in `K ^ 12 < 2 * K ^ 12` (lines 296-302); the `#A < #H` branch shrinks H to H' by `ZModModule.exists_submodule_subset_card_le` (line 308), covers A by cosets of H' via `AddSubgroup.exists_left_transversal_of_le` (line 314), and a `calc` ends in `2 * K ^ 12` (lines 317-337).
claims.evidence: https://github.com/teorth/pfr/blob/1ef23c3c5a83db690fe3b3b5c2e8299fae17b81a/PFR/Main.lean#L294-L337; the file is built by the project's CI (.github/workflows/push.yml, `Build project` job using leanprover/lean-action)

claims.claim: The authors factored the subgroup/covering construction out as a named auxiliary lemma: the doc comment on PFR_conjecture_aux reads 'Auxiliary statement towards the polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa (PFR) conjecture' (lines 149-152), and the glue marks its use with the comment 'consider the subgroup H given by Lemma PFR_conjecture_aux' (line 286).

The glue (proof body, lines 266-337, 72 lines) calls 4 named lemmas directly: PFR_conjecture_pos_aux' (line 285), PFR_conjecture_aux (line 291), ZModModule.exists_submodule_subset_card_le (line 308) and AddSubgroup.exists_left_transversal_of_le (line 314).

The identical move — `wlog` to finite G, a `le_or_gt #H #A` split, a PFR_conjecture_aux-style branch, then the submodule+transversal branch — closes the improved bound theorem PFR_conjecture_improv (PFR/ImprovedPFR.lean, using PFR_conjecture_improv_aux, ZModModule.exists_submodule_subset_card_le and AddSubgroup.exists_left_transversal_of_le).

metrics.how_counted: parent proof = lines 266-337 of PFR/Main.lean (the `by` block of PFR_conjecture); direct_lemmas counted by reading the proof body and listing the named lemmas it applies (the split itself uses Mathlib's `le_or_gt`, and the second branch also uses `natCard_add_le`, both routine library calls not counted)

consequences: Creates two goals from the dichotomy `|H| ≤ |A|`; the exhaustiveness obligation is discharged by Mathlib's `le_or_gt`, so no separate disjunction lemma appears. Each branch must still close a `calc` chain that the `refine ⟨H, c, ...⟩`/`refine ⟨H', c+u, ...⟩` sets up; if the bound exponents change (as in the improved theorem, K^11 instead of K^12), the chain's final `rpow_ring; norm_num` step is the only part that moves. The second branch relies on a submodule-shrinking lemma and a coset-transversal lemma from Mathlib; without them the shrink step does not close.
